name: Microgrid operating-constraint alarm summary
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Collects the active resource and site constraints affecting the selected control objective.
description: Collects the active resource and site constraints affecting the selected control objective. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Named operating constraints” at the input and “Constraint summary indication” at the output. The individual limiting causes should remain visible.
